last_run.note: every step is idempotent, so this is safe to run on each launch, from a scheduler, or by hand. `ok`/`execution_ok` says whether the steps ran; `data` says separately whether new data arrived and whether the corpus is current. The live tick loop is NOT started here: opening a broker connection is an operator decision, not a side effect of opening a dashboard. Start it with `python scripts/run_live.py --status` first, then `--replay --once` or a live run.

acquisition.note: executed, acquired nothing. Every requested session was already stored or not published (a holiday, or the file is not out yet). Nothing downstream is re-derived, because re-deriving unchanged inputs produces identical files.

schedule.note: registered, executed and acquired-fresh-data are three different facts. A task can be registered and never fire; a run can succeed and bring no new data.

health.note: a check with no data reads as never_succeeded or never_run, never as ok: silence is not health

snapshot.note: rebuilt from the live corpus by scripts/snapshot_research_data.py after fresh acquisition

measured.note: feature values at the decision date, computed from data available at that close; parameters estimated through t-1

predicted.definition: probability that the research market index falls 10% or more from this decision close at any close within the next 15 sessions
predicted.model: combined (EWMA volatility + one feature per pillar family)

warning.reason: the forecast 0.0623 is below the calibrated threshold 0.1252
warning.note: the threshold is chosen from past out-of-sample scores and matured outcomes only. A frozen threshold is a policy, not a proof that the future false-alarm budget will be met

history.note: retrospective replay over the available history. It shows what the instrument would have produced, which is implementation behaviour rather than demonstrated foresight

validation.note: No advance-warning skill, calibration or economic effect size has been demonstrated. AMENDMENT-03 measured Pillar 1 at approximately no skill at every intraday horizon and reclassified it as a contagion diagnostic, and the research replay records empirical_acceptance as unvalidated. These are honest limitations of a working instrument, not grounds for treating its output as a validated forecast.
